acceptance: One documented dialect source feeds SQL and DataFrame loaders
pandas NULL group keys match SQL grouping semantics
description: Deferred from the independent adversarial reviews of flightdata-cross-surface-output-contract-burn-down (C3/C4/D7): (1) SQL and DataFrame loaders resolve CSV dialects through separate paths (benchmark attributes vs manifest), so the same manifest metadata is interpreted in two places — consolidate on a single dialect source; (2) pandas groupby drops NULL group keys while SQL keeps NULL groups, so unmatched LEFT JOIN codes diverge on real data — align with dropna=False or equivalent after verifying Dask/cuDF support; (3) the runner's tables-populated early-return path skips ensure_auxiliary_data_files, so stale manifests are not healed there (extend the flightdata backfill hook or heal at that path). None triggers on the synthetic gate data.
